comments.author: Naoyasu
comments.body:
Festive ironsides base material is festive wood (teak equivalent) and has a 110% durability modified. National pannel is 141% modifier, so 1170 base. Thats way with +250 dura reach 1420.
Normal ironsides as you can see in this page, when panneled, has 1001 max dura... so this ship max is 1251. Cosidering you need to use a panel as part of the improvements, to reach max dura you need to use a 1 skill + full dura build, not leaving much room for extra stats in other fields...
Also, NEVER dismantle a non NC battleship! The hull itself adds 60-80 dura and 1-3 armor...
